main.radialoffhand.title: Radial Offhand
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.radialoff: A faster way to put items into offhand
Controls how big the radial menu appears on screen.
config.radialoffhand.option.toggleMode.t: The radial menu stays open after pressing the key and closes when pressed again. Left mouse button (LMB) is used for selection.
config.radialoffhand.option.shownames.to: Shows item name in radial menu slots.
config.radialoffhand.option.hideEmptySlo: If true, empty slots on menu will not appear in the radial menu.
config.radialoffhand.option.useCenterIte: Show a Item Preview In The Center
Enables the item preview shown in the center of the radial menu.
config.radialoffhand.option.useCenterPre: Show Item Description In The Center
Shows the selected item's description in the center of the radial menu.
config.radialoffhand.option.allowMovemen: Allows the player to move while the radial menu is open.
config.radialoffhand.option.usePriorityS: Sorts items by category: Totem, Defense, Mobility(Fireworks), Torches, Food, Blocks.
config.radialoffhand.option.excludeHotba: Exclude hotbar slots from the radial menu.
config.radialoffhand.option.onlyShowCons: Only display consumable items in the radial menu. Middle-click an item in the radial menu to add or remove it. Hold the Show All Items key (Left Alt by default) to temporarily show all items.
config.radialoffhand.option.showConsumab: Include consumable items from the hotbar even when it is excluded.
config.radialoffhand.option.useMenuBackg: Enables or disables background dimming(blur effects) in menus.
config.radialoffhand.option.showSlotBack: Draws a slot frame behind each item in the radial menu.
config.radialoffhand.option.useRightClic: Right click while the radial menu is open to move the offhand item back into your inventory. Nothing happens if there is no free slot.
config.radialoffhand.option.unequipPrior: Where the unequipped item goes first. If that area is full, the other one is used.
config.radialoffhand.option.consumableWh: Items that always count as consumables, e.g. minecraft:spyglass. Easier way: middle-click an item in the radial menu.
config.radialoffhand.option.consumableBl: Items that never count as consumables. Easier way: middle-click an item in the radial menu.
message.radialoffhand.consumable.removed: %s no longer counts as a consumable
